notes: Names printed without a suffix (TOWNSHIP, BADER) are written with 'Street'. Township (50') rises ENE across the top; Bader (50') runs parallel to it in the middle; Marshall (60') runs along the bottom. Colerain runs down the left side against the binding: its west line is only visible from y~1990 down (x~102 at y 1990) and is compressed by the page curve (faces ~47 ft apart as scanned); at Township its west line is in the gutter, so the Colerain/Township point uses the east line (block corners 260,1569 / 338,1858), the west line extrapolated (~x 34) and the Township water pipe junction (~160,1780); uncertain by ~20 px. Township's west end at Colerain is the 50 ft east leg of sheet 273 (T there too). Henshaw runs from Township to Bader and stops (Bader's south line continuous), so T. Sidney ends at Marshall (Marshall's south line continuous), T. Bader runs from Colerain (T, Colerain's west line continuous) east across Massachusetts onto 275. Township and Bader continue east of Massachusetts onto 275; Colerain and Massachusetts continue south of Marshall (255). The Bader water pipe runs ~30 px north of the street centre; points use the block corners. No alleys (all interior lines are lot lines). Circled figures are grade elevations.
